messages:
nina: Heads-up: found an intermittent parity bug between Java and Kotlin SDK flows when an auth refresh (401->refresh->replay) happens during a chunked multipart upload. Java callback path retries fine, but our Coroutine/suspend helper fails with a closed-stream IOException. Repro in sampleapp on Android 14 emulator.

chao: Can you paste okhttp/retrofit versions + stack?

nina: Retrofit 2.9, OkHttp 4.12.0, Kotlin 1.9. Stack: `java.io.IOException: stream closed` from RequestBody.writeTo -> okio.ForwardingSink.write, followed by `okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamAllocation.streamFailed`. Happens only under token-refresh scenario, not plain network error.

wayne: My bet: suspend adapter reuses the original Call or doesn't clone before replaying, so a once-only RequestBody is exhausted. Java path probably creates a fresh Call when the interceptor replays.

priya: Also check cancellation semantics. If the suspend wrapper ties coroutine cancellation to the underlying Call.cancel() then an auth retry that tries to re-execute the same Call can hit a cancelled/closed stream. We saw similar on connection reuse.

nina: Good point — the suspend helper calls `call.enqueue` and uses a Continuation resume; it cancels on coroutine cancel. But the bug reproduces even without explicit cancellation. I logged the call id and see same Call instance across attempts.

chao: Two practical fixes: 1) ensure suspend adapter clones the Call for every execution attempt (`val exec = call.clone()`), 2) detect non-repeatable RequestBody and emit a clear WARN with guidance to use a repeatable wrapper or temp-file-backed RepeatableRequestBody util.

wayne: For big files we should avoid in-memory buffering. I can prototype a RepeatableRequestBody that writes to a temp file (streams once, then replays by streaming from file). We'll add cleanup and an opt-in API.

priya: Also add an integration test that simulates mid-stream 401 and verifies both Java and Kotlin flows behave the same across API 29/33/34. We had flaky instrumented tests in the past; mark them as flaky but keep coverage.

nina: I'll attach a small repro (auth-proxy that returns 401 after first N bytes). Also adding device matrix logs. Short-term note in onboarding sampleapp: "Kotlin suspend upload helper is vulnerable to one-shot RequestBody during auth refresh; prefer Java callback or use RepeatableRequestBody until fix ships."

ci-bot: ci: PR #4820 created for suspend-adapter clone + warning log. Unit tests passed :white_check_mark: instrumented upload test failing on API 34 emulator :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

wayne: I'll open a follow-up PR for temp-file-backed RepeatableRequestBody and an instrumented e2e that runs in CI with increased retries.

chao: Small doc task: add a troubleshooting page under SDK docs "Uploads and auth refresh" with examples for buffered and temp-file backends plus perf tradeoffs.

nina: Filed INF-9900 with repro zip and logs. Assigning @wayne for util PR and @priya for tests. Thanks! :thumbsup:
